title: What Does 120/80 Mean? Blood Pressure Explained (Systolic vs Diastolic)
description:
Blood pressure • Systolic and diastolic • What does 120/80 mean

Blood pressure explained simply: what systolic and diastolic pressure mean, what 120/80 mmHg tells you, and how your body controls blood pressure every second. We follow the blood from the left ventricle into the aorta to see where the top and bottom numbers come from, learn how a blood pressure cuff works, and break down the normal, elevated and high blood pressure ranges for adults. You'll learn the key formula, blood pressure = cardiac output x resistance, and how baroreceptors in the carotid arteries and aortic arch, plus the kidneys and the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS), keep your pressure in balance. Perfect for MBBS, nursing, pharmacy and biology students.

title: Why Is High Blood Pressure Called the Silent Killer? Hypertension Explained
description:
High blood pressure • Hypertension explained • Silent killer

You'll see why it's called the silent killer, the organs it harms (heart attack, stroke, heart failure, kidney damage and the eyes), the emergency warning signs above 180/120, and the lifestyle changes and medicines that keep it under control. title: What Is Heart Failure? Why the Heart Gets Weak (Symptoms, Causes & Treatment)
description:
Heart failure • Congestive heart failure • Heart failure symptoms

Heart failure explained simply: it does not mean the heart has stopped. It means the heart cannot pump enough blood for the body, because the muscle is too weak to squeeze or too stiff to fill. Learn the main causes (heart attack, high blood pressure, valve disease, cardiomyopathy, diabetes), what ejection fraction means, why left-sided heart failure causes breathlessness and fluid in the lungs, why right-sided heart failure causes swollen legs and ankles (pitting edema), the warning signs, how doctors diagnose it (BNP blood test, chest x-ray, echocardiogram) and how it is treated.
